question: Should paired-node terminal staging remain an internal capability reachable only through an owned terminal session, or become a general operator.admin node file-staging command?
rationale: The linked issue promises session ownership, but the current command registration creates a broader permanent node API; maintainers must confirm that trust boundary before merge.

options.title: Keep staging session-only
options.body: Exclude terminal.upload from direct node.invoke and authorize the internal relay against the exact terminal session and node connection.

options.title: Approve a general node command
options.body: Intentionally document and test terminal.upload as a standalone operator.admin file-staging API with explicit upgrade and security semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep staging session-only
recommendation.body: Exclude terminal.upload from direct node.invoke and authorize the internal relay against the exact terminal session and node connection.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature issue and implementation series establish the intended terminal-upload contract and product boundary.
